mo_brief.title: MAJOR ORDER
mo_brief.original: Uphold election security by destroying all those who would threaten it.
mo_brief.translated: 维护选举安全：消灭一切胆敢威胁它的人。

items.original:
CAMPAIGN FAILURE

Cyborg interference has raised significant doubts in the veracity of the Quarter-Term Elections. As a result, a re-vote has been ordered, with enhanced election security measures to make interference impossible.

SEAF Battalions have been recalled from the frontlines to secure voting sites.
items.translated:
战役失败

生化人的干预，令期中选举的真实性备受质疑。为此，最高司令部已下令重新投票，并加设更严密的选举安保措施，确保干预无从下手。

SEAF 各营已从前线召回，负责守卫投票站点。

items.original:
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION

Funds from the Super Secure Elections Act have been allocated to support Helldiver operations on ROGUE 5 with the Anti-Personnel Mine Deployer Stratagem for the next 24 hours.
items.translated:
军械库扩充

《超级安全选举法》拨出的资金已获分配，将在未来24小时内以“反步兵地雷部署器”战略配备支援绝地潜兵在罗格5的行动。
